purpose: Teach: 供養/守護/物色/不特定/贈与/再婚/勝訴/虚構

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、亡くなられた社員の供養に手厚く対応しろ
lines.en: Make sure we handle the memorial and support for our deceased employees with the utmost care.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear diction on each clause. Weight in the voice — this is a statement of values, not a request. Pause before the core directive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の守護的な福利厚生を充実させます
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen our employee support and benefits across the board.
lines.style: Steady, absorbing the directive without fanfare. Slight forward lean in the tone — shows immediate comprehension and commitment. Professional, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合が物色する優秀な人材を引き留めろ
lines.en: And retain the talented people our competitors are already looking at.
lines.style: Shift to sharper urgency. Clipped pacing on the competitive angle. No pause — this follows naturally from the first directive. Emphasis on 'retain' as an action, not a hope.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不特定多数への広告を見直しております
lines.en: Yes. We're already reconsidering our recruitment advertising strategy.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, then immediate evidence of forward motion. Calm, competent — shows he's already anticipated this. Tone says 'we're on it.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、贈与に頼らない独自の経営をしろ
lines.en: Build our management on solid ground — not on gifts or favors.
lines.style: Slight hardening here. Concrete emphasis on 'solid ground.' The directness increases. This is about integrity, so the voice carries that weight without being harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。再婚社員への配慮を整備しております
lines.en: Yes. We're putting safeguards in place to ensure we're treating all employees fairly, regardless of personal circumstances.
lines.style: Slightly longer response showing depth of understanding. Steady throughout. A hint of care underneath the competence — he gets why this matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、訴訟で勝訴するための準備を怠るな
lines.en: Don't cut corners on lawsuit preparation. This is where we need to be airtight.
lines.style: Final directive — firmest yet. Sharp attack on 'don't cut corners.' Lower register, slower pace. Finality in the voice, like the last word that settles everything.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。虚構の評判に振り回されません
lines.en: Understood. We won't be thrown off course by rumors or unfounded claims.
lines.style: Close-out acknowledgment. Quieter than the others — almost reflective. Shows he understands the deeper stakes. Steady, no doubt, but with the quiet gravity of someone who's listened well.
